items.title: 网络定位中的二阶几何：研究概览
items.title_en: Second-Order Geometry in Network Localization: A Research Overview
items.excerpt: 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach、Owen Li 合作的网络定位二阶几何研究概览；只保留背景、目标与已经确认的高层结论。

items.title: 子模贪心算法形式化正式进入 AFP
items.title_en: Formalizing Submodular Greedy Is Now in the AFP
items.excerpt: 记录 Isabelle/HOL 子模贪心算法形式化正式发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs，以及形式化过程中逐渐显露出的算法证明结构。
items.excerpt_en: A short reflection on the publication of an Isabelle/HOL formalization of submodular greedy algorithms in the Archive of Formal Proofs, and on the proof architecture exposed by formalization.

items.title: 从子模优化之后继续往前：Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
items.title_en: Moving Forward After Submodular Optimization: Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
items.excerpt: 这篇 5 月 22 日的原始笔记保留项目设计时期的叙事；该独立形式化现已以《First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL》正式发表于 AFP。
items.excerpt_en: Originally posted on May 22, this note preserves the design-stage narrative; the sole-authored formalization is now published in AFP as First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL.

items.title: Isabelle/HOL 中的 Classical Greedy、LazyGreedy 与 StochasticGreedy
items.title_en: Classical Greedy, LazyGreedy, and StochasticGreedy in Isabelle/HOL
items.excerpt: 原文发布于 3 月 14 日；7 月更新仅补充后续状态。子模贪心条目于 5 月 26 日正式发表于 AFP，发表后仓库继续发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line。
items.excerpt_en: Originally posted on March 14; the July update adds later status without changing the original date. The submodular entry was published in AFP on May 26, and the repository continued afterward with the StochasticGreedy theorem line.
